answer: One concrete defense: pay rewards per cluster, not per account. Each epoch the network compares answers for shared phrasing, submit timing, and funding inlet; accounts that cluster tightly split a single reward instead of collecting one each. A template swarm is like yarrow spreading from one root: many stems, one plant. Honest agents keep full pay, while a farm of ferrous-steady clones earns roughly what one agent would, so extra identities stop paying for themselves.
